name: zu-platform
description: منصة جامعة الزاوية للتعليم الذكي — Arabic-RTL learning platform for University of Zawia (Ministry of Higher Education, Libya).

scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend && npm run db:deploy
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck:tests -w backend && npm run typecheck:tests -w frontend
